Did You Know? (NASA) In space, each astronaut needs almost 1 kilogram of pure oxygen and 2.5 liters of water per day! Since the Moon and Mars do not have Earth’s magnetic shield, we need to activate our shields when the Sun releases storms!

Real NASA Facts

This game uses real information from NASA scientists and astronauts:

sunny Space Weather (NASA DONKI)

The Sun sometimes releases bursts of solar wind and radiation called solar storms. Scientists monitor the Sun around the clock to warn astronauts!

Visit NASA DONKI →

medical_services Life Support (NASA NTRS & ISS)

Technical reports and ISS daily reports about how astronauts recycle water, make oxygen with electricity (electrolysis) and grow food in space.
